import re
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

url_regex = re.compile(r'https://example\.com/[0-9]+$')

response = requests.get('https://www.example.com')
html = response.text

soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
links = soup.find_all('a')

for link in links:
    url = link.get('href')
    if url_regex.match(url):
        print(url)
